description:
Bandit Camp games' rules: Big Wheel, blackjack, poker and slots. The rules behind https://rust.wiki/calculators/big-wheel, /calculators/blackjack and /calculators/poker-odds:
the wheel's segments and payout, blackjack's table rules, poker's (no rake) and the slot machines' paytable. Each
rule carries how sure it is (`confirmed` by Facepunch, `corroborated`, `unconfirmed`). Slot machine odds and the
house's cut aren't published anywhere. These are Rust's in-game scrap games - nothing to do with real money.
name: get_bandit_camp_rules
